name: Sheet-pan dinner
intro: One vegetable, one fish, one pan, a hot oven, and the jar after. The shape you'll make most this month.
season_anchor: Kabocha wedges, or sweet potato in cubes
Rockfish fillets, for the last ten minutes

variations.context: The October version. Squash goes in first; fish joins it for the last ten minutes.
When the kabocha's gone. Same timing.
No fish this week. The egg goes on at the table.

finish: Heat the oven to 425°F. Squash and peppers go in first, oiled and salted, with room between the pieces, for about twenty minutes. Then push them aside, lay the fish in the gap, salt it, and give it ten more. Ajvar and a squeeze of lemon over everything at the table.
